title: Quick scrub: workload sampler & owner stub
content:
Purpose:
A short, pragmatic sample of active cross-functional asks surfaced in the last 2 weeks. Goal is to produce a terse owner/contact stub, a lightweight hours estimate, and a minimal dependency flag so product-ops / on-call leads can prioritize coverage for the coming 7 days. Not intended as exhaustive tracker — this is a 20-minute sampler to reduce noise for the weekend handoff.

Scope & method:
- Sample window: 2029-10-07 -> 2029-10-20
- Sources: hand-picked Slack threads, mini postmortems, current sprint board (tag: ops/coverage), and 1:1 owner check-ins.
- Inclusion rule: any ask with cross-team coordination or potential capacity impact > 2 hours.

High-level summary (sample of 18 asks):
- Sampled opens: 18
- Estimated total effort (sum of med estimates): 48-62 hours
- High-priority (blocker/region-specific): 4
- Needs infra support (GPU/network changes): 6
- Has compliance/privileged access dependency: 2

Mini table (ask / owner / est hrs / impact / dep / status):
1) telemetry delta: missing endpoint traces for regional fallbacks / Owner: Marcus Chen / 4-6h / High (latency OOS) / Dep: infra-telemetry ticket ENG-4879 / Status: in_progress
2) fallback docs: update routing fallbacks doc for APAC region / Owner: Rina Patel / 3h / Medium / Dep: legal review for wording / Status: todo
3) canary config: small-burst policy for dedicated pools (beta) / Owner: Benji Liu / 6-8h / High (launch risk) / Dep: infra capacity signoff / Status: in_review
4) embedding-cost-scan: quick run on 7 customers with heavy batch usage / Owner: Aisha Khatri / 5h / Medium / Dep: billing export access / Status: todo
5) partner-reconnect: handoff for partner SLA exception (priority contact list) / Owner: TBD (recommended: Customer Success) / 2h / High / Dep: partner contract copy / Status: blocked
6) temp-runbook: weekend surge runbook for midnight PST spikes / Owner: Marcus Chen / 2h / Low / Dep: none / Status: todo
7) model-variant-tagging: add explicit tag to allow smart-routing fallback / Owner: Platform-ml (signal: @katy) / 4h / Medium / Dep: model-catalog PR / Status: in_progress
8) docs-light: console dashboard quicklink for per-route latency / Owner: Rina Patel / 1-2h / Low / Dep: UI small ticket / Status: todo
9) audit-sample: 10 request traces for Private deploy onboarding review / Owner: Security (recommended: Elena) / 3h / High / Dep: KMS access grant / Status: todo
10) quickfix-rate-limiter: emergency throttle for misbehaving client / Owner: Benji Liu / 3h / High / Dep: alerting link / Status: in_progress
(remaining 8 asks summarized below)
- misc: small API contract clarifications (4 asks, 0.5-1h each) / owners: product engineering / status: todo
- infra: node padding config checks (2 asks, 2h each) / owners: infra ops / status: todo
- billing: credits reconciliation for early adopter (1 ask, 2h) / owner: finance / status: todo

Notable risks & blocking items:
- Two asks require temporary KMS/HSM access; provisioning lead time is estimated at 48–72 hours — escalate if needed for this week.
- Partner recon (item 5) has no owner assigned; suggest CS lead @maria to pick up or we risk SLA exception.
- Canary config depends on capacity signoff from Dedicated team (tickets open, waiting on capacity run).

Quick decisions needed by Monday EOD:
- Confirm owner for partner-reconnect (item 5).
- Approve temporary KMS access for audit-sample (item 9) or schedule delay.
- Greenlight small-burst canary for dedicated pools with implied rollback plan.

Next steps / playbook (minimal):
- Product-ops (Aisha) will ping listed owners in one thread (template below) and request ETA update by Mon 10:00 PT.
- If owner is "TBD" assign auto-escalation to team lead in 24h.
- For infra/KMS blockers: open a 1h sync with SRE and Security with a pre-read (include the two asks and Krya short justification).

Template ping to owners (one-thread):
Hi <owner>, quick scrub found "<ask title>" in this sample. Short ask: <1-line>. Estimated effort: <hrs>. Blockers: <dep>. Please reply with status + ETA by Mon 10:00 PT. If you can't own it, suggest the correct owner or "assign to team lead" so product-ops can escalate.

Notes / randoms (notes-to-self style):
- Keep this doc lightweight — if an ask grows >8h move to a tracked spreadsheet (owners should create a Jira ticket).
- Save a copy to confluence folder: /ops/quick-scrub/2029-10 for historical pattern analysis.

Appendix: raw pointers captured while sampling
- Slack thread: #ops-shifts, ts=1697602000 (telemetry traces)
- Sprint board filter: label: ops/coverage + created:>2029-10-01
- Billing export: s3://billing/exports/2029-10 (request via finance)

— Aisha (product-ops)
